question.prompt: Circle \(O\) has radius 5. Point \(P\) lies outside circle \(O\), and the shortest distance from \(P\) to a point on circle \(O\) is 3. Find the longest distance from \(P\) to a point on circle \(O\).

solutions.explanation: The shortest distance is \(OP-5=3\), so \(OP=8\). The longest distance is \(OP+5=13\).
solutions.title: Use the nearest and farthest radial distances
